scope: Finite overlap selection: neither paper is a Nov20/21 first release; no full-source or watermark-advance claim.
available_resource: one A100 or A30, or local Mac

accepted.title: FrontierReplay: Split-Free Exact Prefix Caching for Hybrid Language Models
accepted.scope: A CPU-only host-policy component implements observed-boundary planning, explicit pending/completion publication, leases, tiered admission/eviction, long-prefix protection and a sixteen-request reclaim decision. The caller supplies KV residency, observed progress, stable ends and non-self eviction signals; there is no autonomous service or user-log observation. Slots contain synthetic token-prefix metadata, not model state. No GDN/Mamba replay kernel, precision-rounding bitmask, vLLM, CUDA event, VMM or actual memory lending is implemented. This is not exact CUDA replay, serving integration or a throughput reproduction.
accepted.cost_basis: The complete study spans five4B–34B models, four long-context workloads, multiple baseline/load/SLO sweeps and native Triton/vLLM integration. The27B/34B runs explicitly require two-way tensor parallelism, and some points have three paired runs. The complete campaign is too expensive for routine single-A100/A30 or Mac reproduction. Only CPU policy diagnostics are budgeted below10seconds across three seeds, without model/data downloads, APIs or native serving. This is a budget estimate, not measured full-experiment time.

accepted.title: MV-JEPA: Post-Training Video Encoders for Cross-View Understanding
accepted.scope: A real tiny shared self-attention encoder, independently encoded contexts, joint predictor, two query types, distinct view IDs, teacher-only held-out targets, Eq4 loss, shared single-view replay and explicit EMA are implemented. Inputs are synthetic token features, not pixels; no V-JEPA weights are loaded. The declared tiny one-dimensional sinusoidal encoding is not the native spatiotemporal position code. Eight-block video masks, data crops/decoding, V-JEPA2.1 multi-layer5632-dimensional targets and visible-distance weighting, full training and real retrieval are absent. Isolation/gradient diagnostics are not visual capability or Evolve evidence.
accepted.cost_basis: The paper explicitly uses16-frame256×256 inputs, multiview batch48/replay24 and9000updates over30epochs; V-JEPA2-L takes roughly18hours on one RTX PRO6000 Blackwell. MVImgNet2.0/Ego-Exo4D, ImageNet/Kinetics/SSv2 replay and many probes add cost. The complete experiment is too expensive for this single-A100/A30 or Mac budget and is not attempted. Only an8-wide tiny token mechanism is budgeted below30seconds across three seeds, with no model/data downloads or APIs. CPU tests do not complete CUDA validation; that requires this batch's real-GPU receipt.

selection_notes: Both papers are genuine new selections from the Nov20 bulletin, not newly first-published today.
MV-JEPA first-author affiliation is UMN; Cisco collaboration and V-JEPA backbone do not make it a Meta paper.
Unrelated SCU-zly/GGO-JEPA medical CT code is not the MV-JEPA paper's author release.
No complete training/serving campaign, checkpoint/data download, paid API or Evolve promotion.
